facts.text: Pack the eggs, the sandwiches and a spare pair of goggles. I am not landing in a foreign country without my dinner.
facts.why: Set out as Grandpa Potts's words under 'From the flight deck', but he never says it, and he does not fly to Vulgaria in the car. The Vulgarians kidnap him in the airship and the Potts family flies after him to rescue him.
facts.fix: Pack the eggs and the sandwiches. We fly to Vulgaria to fetch Grandpa, and nobody rescues anyone hungry.

facts.text: Truly's father, the sweet factory lord who won't buy the Toot Sweets.
facts.why: At the end of the film Lord Scrumptious offers to buy Caractacus's failed candies and sell them as dog treats.
facts.fix: Truly's father, the sweet factory lord who buys the Toot Sweets for the dogs.

facts.text: Packed by Truly Scrumptious in the picnic hamper.
facts.why: The children fetch the picnic basket and offer Truly sausage tarts and marmalade rolls on the beach. Truly joins the picnic later and does not pack it.
facts.fix: Packed by Jemima and Jeremy in the picnic basket.
